author: claude
summary: Adds a client-side elapsed-seconds counter to the Engines page's per-engine 'Verify' button, since engine verification (POST /engines/{id}/verify) is a synchronous blocking call with no orchestrator task/queue entry and no TTS event-stream data to show progress from -- the button now reads 'Verifying... Ns' (ticking every second via a plain setInterval off performance.now()) and the tooltip mirrors it, instead of a static 'Verifying...' spinner with no sense of how long the cold-start wait has been running.

files.change: New verifyElapsedSec state plus a useEffect keyed on `verifying` that starts a 1s setInterval computing elapsed time from performance.now() and resets to 0 when verifying goes false. The Verify button's label and title attribute now interpolate this value while verifying is true.
